# Temple Dash

> Temple Dash is a free 3D endless runner set in an ancient temple. Switch lanes, jump, slide, dodge obstacles, and collect coins to upgrade permanent power-ups.

## Pages

- [Play Temple Dash](/): The main game — start a run, pick a character, beat your high score.
- [Temple Shop](/shop): Spend earned coins on permanent upgrades (magnet, speed, invincibility, shield, coin multiplier, head start) or buy coin packs.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): What data Temple Dash collects and how it's used.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Rules for using Temple Dash and purchasing in-game items.
